psychological_meaning: Turtle Green evokes feelings of nature, stability, and growth. It represents a grounded energy and promotes a sense of calm and connection to the earth. This color often signifies prosperity, health, and environmental awareness, suggesting a harmonious balance between ambition and tranquility.
